name: Welcome
description: Greet every new member with a styled embed in a channel you choose.

defaults.title: Welcome to {server}
defaults.description: Hey {user}, glad you joined. You are member number {memberCount}. Read the rules, say hi and make yourself at home.

form.enabledHelp: Post a message when someone joins. Bots are skipped.
form.languageHelp: Changes the dashboard and the default texts the bot sends.
form.channelHelp: Only text channels where ShifuBot can write are listed.
form.noChannels: ShifuBot cannot write in any text channel. Give it the Send Messages and Embed Links permissions.
form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.
form.showAvatarHelp: Displays the avatar as a thumbnail in the corner.
form.bannerHelp: A wide image shown at the bottom. Must start with http:// or https://.
form.footerHelp: Leave empty for the standard ShifuBot footer.
form.mentionHelp: Pings the member above the embed so they get a notification.

status.noChannel: Pick a channel so ShifuBot knows where to post.
status.channelMissing: The selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.missingPermissions: ShifuBot is missing permissions in this channel: {permissions}.
status.rateLimited: Raid protection: at most {count} welcome messages per minute.

test.help: Sends the message above to the channel as if you just joined.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: This is exactly what Discord will show.

setup.title: Welcome messages
setup.description: Greet new members in a channel of your choice. Fine tune texts and colors later on the Welcome page.
setup.channelRequired: Pick a channel, or turn welcome messages off for now.
